name: חֶזְיוֹן
summary: An Aramean, grandfather of Ben-hadad king of Aram at Damascus in the days of Asa (1Ki 15:18). The name is the noun חִזָּיוֹן “vision” in the spelling of Job 33:15 (חֶזְיוֹן לַיְלָה “a vision of the night”).

evidence.note: “Ben-hadad son of Tabrimmon son of חֶזְיוֹן, king of Aram.”
“In a dream, in a vision (חֶזְיוֹן) of the night”: the same form as a noun.

note: Takes h.bp.ah, whose two tokens are this name and the noun at Job 33:15 (also under h.bp.ag); the word sheet counts both. Some identify Hezion with Rezon of 1Ki 11:23; not shown by scripture.
